sentences.en: Alcohol mixed with energy drinks can be a dangerous combination.
sentences.zh: 酒精和能量饮料混合起来可能会形成一种危险的结合。

sentences.en: Sami gave Layla the combination to open his gun safe.
sentences.zh: 萨米把打开他手枪保险柜的密码给了莱拉。

sentences.en: A combination of several mistakes led to the accident.
sentences.zh: 一系列错误的结合导致了事故的发生。

senses.zh: 结合，组合；联合，结合体；密码锁
